BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   C. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

7. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   B. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Banking as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   B. Treat Money as rumours only.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Money never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Books of Original Entry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Money and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Business Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
